title: tc-help-guide
description: Point-in-time help from the help center: a small guide icon to put beside a heading or label, linking to one written tutorial.

heading.description: The guide's title – the tooltip and the link's accessible name

href.description: Where the guide is: a page in the help center

minutes.description: How long it takes to read, in minutes – "5 min read" in the tooltip

sameTab.description: Opens the guide in this tab rather than a new one

label.description: Words beside the icon, e.g. "Read the guide"; unset, the icon stands alone with a tooltip

size.description: The icon's size against the text around it: "sm" (1em), "md" (1.25em, the default) or "lg" (1.5em)

read.description: Whether it has been read – a check on the icon. Set when it's opened, unless a tc-read-change listener calls preventDefault()

updatedOn.description: When the guide last changed, as a date ("2026-11-17"); for `new-days` days after it, a dot on the icon says so

newDays.description: How many days after `updated-on` the dot shows (default 14)

updateSeen.description: Whether this person has seen the update – the dot is cleared. Set when the guide is opened, unless a tc-update-seen-change listener calls preventDefault()

now.description: The time to measure `new-days` from, in milliseconds; unset, the clock's
